summary: Tested Survey Results Fix and Booking Overview features. Found and fixed a bug where survey voting failed with 422 error when priority_order was null. All features now working correctly.
updated_files: /app/backend/models.py - Fixed GeneralPollVoteRequest.priority_order to accept Optional[list] instead of list (was causing 422 error when frontend sent null)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Survey results fix and booking overview features fully working. Fixed priority_order null handling in GeneralPollVoteRequest model.

backend_api_tests: GET /api/general-polls/public/{share_token} returns votes with selected_options field ✓
GET /api/booking/all-bookings returns all bookings for authenticated user ✓
GET /api/booking/pages/{page_id}/bookings returns bookings filtered by page ✓
frontend_tests: /survey/{token} page shows Ergebnisse section with vote counts and percentage bars ✓
/survey/{token} voting works correctly with toast 'Abstimmung gespeichert!' ✓
/survey/{token} results update after voting (Option C went from 0 to 1 Stimmen) ✓
/booking/settings page loads with booking page cards ✓
/booking/settings 'Buchungen anzeigen' toggle expands to show page bookings ✓
/booking/settings 'Alle Buchungen anzeigen' toggle shows all bookings with guest name, date, time, status ✓
/booking/settings 'Stornieren' button cancels booking with toast 'Buchung storniert' ✓

survey_voting_422_error.issue: Survey voting failed with 422 Unprocessable Entity when priority_order was null
survey_voting_422_error.root_cause: GeneralPollVoteRequest model had priority_order: list = [] which rejected null values
survey_voting_422_error.fix: Changed to priority_order: Optional[list] = [] to accept both null and empty list

mocked_apis.email_sending: Email delivery falls back to mock if Resend API key is missing
